run_GEOMANCER_fit: run the GEOMANCER fit function to estimate manifold components from a dataset of points
build_knn_graph: build a k-nearest neighbors graph from numpy data using make_nearest_neighbors_graph
compute_tangent_vectors: compute tangent vectors for each data point using make_tangents with a neighbor graph
run_ffdiag_diagonalization: run the orthogonal FFDiag algorithm to simultaneously diagonalize a set of matrices
cluster_eigenvector_subspaces: cluster subspace dimensions from Laplacian eigenvectors using cluster_subspaces and ffdiag
